'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Russian rockets hit a residential building in the city of [[Kryvyi Rih]], [[Dnipropetrovsk oblast]], killing 11 people and injuring 28 others. '''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Grammys]] announce new award categories: Best Pop Dance Recording, Best Alternative Jazz Album and Best African Music Performance. [https://pitchfork.com/news/recording-academy-adds-new-awards-for-2024-grammys-best-alternative-jazz-album-best-pop-dance-recording-and-best-african-music-performance/ (Pitchfork)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Kwara boat disaster]]
**At least 100 people are killed when a [[wedding]] boat [[capsize]]s on the [[Niger River]] in [[Kwara State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/nigeria-at-least-100-people-killed-after-boat-capsizes-12901819 (Sky News)]
*[[2023 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Biparjoy]] approaches [[India]] and [[Pakistan]], with seven people being killed in India. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/seven-dead-india-steps-up-evacuations-ahead-cyclone-2023-06-13/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are injured and buildings are damaged by a magnitude 5.0 [[list of earthquakes in India|earthquake]] in [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], India. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/chandigarh-news/powerful-5-4-magnitude-earthquake-hits-jammu-and-kashmir-damages-buildings-and-causes-panic-among-people-101686681926774.html (The Hindustan Times)]
*Fifteen people are killed and two others are injured after a minibus collides into a parked pickup truck in [[El Saff]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/crash-car-accident-egypt-road-alsaff-e60093ec4a603e958004323fd00df184 (AP)]
*Fifteen people are killed and several others are injured when two passenger buses collide with a truck between [[Fana, Mali|Fana]] and [[Konobougou]], [[Mali]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-bus-crash-killed-c558d6dc2f73307803a735fd913d6ab3 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Nottingham attacks]]
**Three people are killed in two stabbings and three others are injured in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] in [[Nottingham]], [[England]]. [[Nottinghamshire Police|Police]] arrest a 31-year-old West African man in connection with the attacks. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-nottinghamshire-65887752 (BBC News)]
*Nine people are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Denver]], [[Colorado]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-65888631 (BBC News)]
*The [[Legislative Assembly of El Salvador]] votes to reduce the number of [[Municipalities of El Salvador|municipalities]] in the country from 262 to 44 ahead of the [[2024 Salvadoran general election|general elections in 2024]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-consolidates-local-governments-opposition-warns-power-grab-2023-06-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 CONCACAF Gold Cup]]
**In [[association football]], [[Nicaragua national football team|Nicaragua]] is banned from the 2023 [[CONCACAF Gold Cup]] for fielding an ineligible player for eight matches and will be replaced by [[Trinidad and Tobago national football team|Trinidad and Tobago]]. [https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/nicaragua-banned-from-2023-gold-cup-for-fielding-ineligible-player/ (CBS Sports)]
*[[2023 Stanley Cup playoffs]]
**In [[ice hockey]], the [[Vegas Golden Knights]] win their first [[Stanley Cup]] after defeating the [[Florida Panthers]] in five games of a [[Playoff format#Best-of-seven playoff|best-of-seven series]] in the [[2023 Stanley Cup Final|Stanley Cup Final]]. [[Canadians|Canadian]] [[Forward (ice hockey)|forward]] [[Jonathan Marchessault]] wins the [[Conn Smythe Trophy]]. [https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nhl/news/panthers-golden-knights-score-updates-highlights-stanley-cup-game-5/iidvr3peft65igo5lct8otpn (The Sporting News)]
